notes.title: Patch#7
notes.content:
Fixed a durability bug where androids with 0 durability could still work for one wave after entering combat.
 ​​Fixed an evacuation bug where overweight abandoned items would mysteriously return to the ship​​. [spoiler] (Did inanimate objects gain sentience?) [/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch#6
notes.content:
Added a [Mod Warehouse] to the Production Zone and adjusted module spawn rates.​​
 ​​Removed the prerequisite for unlocking the [Dismantle] function—it’s now available immediately after repairing the [Research Center].

notes.title: Patch#5
notes.content:
Increased the duration of [Paralysis] caused by Aerial bombs.
 ​​Adjusted Threat Level calculations—it now escalates faster.
 ​​Modified spawn rates in Residential Zones—more Machine Gun Turrets now appear.

notes.title: Patch#4
notes.content:
Visual improvements to the region map.​
 ​​Enhanced squad selection UI in the preparation screen.
 ​​Fixed a crafting bug that prevented researched mods from being produced.
 ​​Fixed a bug with Sentry Guns causing errors when triggering[spoiler] [Liberate] [/spoiler] after mod installation.

notes.title: Patch#3
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the Repair function would not properly unlock.
 ​​Fixed a bug where Flash Bomb Analyze did not grant crafting permissions.

notes.title: Patch#2
notes.content:
Adjusted the spawn rate of Advanced Chips in Vaults.
 ​​Fixed a bug with Ultimate Chips that prevented unit deployment cancellation after Tactical Relocation.

notes.title: Patch#1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where Strongholds would not provide population growth.
 ​​Fixed incorrect enemy spawn types in certain regions.

notes.title: Under the Ruin Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Patch Notes:​

​Enhanced Unit Inspection - You can now view ​​detailed unit attributes during battles​​, as shown below:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652778/ebe507faa33a1089175b3d2408e989d3daaa9965.png"]

Streamlined Tutorials -​ New player guides will now ​​pop up proactively​​ instead of being hidden in a tips menu.

UI Refinements -​​ Minor interface optimizations.

Early-game adjustment - Encounter rates for \[Testing] and \[Research] Zones have been increased. These zones have higher chances to yield unique modules.

​
PS: To align with the significant differences between the ​​Demo​​ and ​​full release​​, this Demo version will be ​​retired one week after the Steam Next Fest​​. To continue testing, join our ​​offical Discord​​ for the latest PlayTest updates!

notes.title: Under the Ruin Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Dear Players,​​

Thank you all for playing my Demo! I’ve carefully read every piece of feedback and have made the following temporary improvements:

​​Clearer Tutorials:​​ Most basic guides now include ​​illustrations​​, so you’ll know exactly what to do—like this:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652778/7abfabef39340c256e59fa45116a345b49715c97.png"]

​​Better Visibility at Night:​​ The dark scenes are now ​​a little brighter​​—no more eye strain!

​​Laser Weapon Buff:​​ Their accuracy has been ​​significantly improved​​, making them great for hitting tricky targets.

​​Keep the feedback coming—it’s incredibly helpful for improving the game!​
